title: From Promise to Practice: Closing the Application Gap in Quantum Computing
summary: Quantum computing is a deep technology whose progress cannot be driven effectively from one direction alone. While the field has developed a growing catalogue of mathematically grounded algorithmic speedups, industrial impact will depend just as much on starting from real industrial decision contexts and working downward to what must be computed, validated and integrated. In this Perspective, I argue that sustained progress requires treating these two directions: bottom-up development from physics, hardware and algorithms, and top-down development from industrial needs and constraints.…
